en: A color postcard showing a panoramic view over the historic center of a Central/Eastern European city. In the foreground, on the left, there is a rooftop monument with a chariot-like sculpture: a figure reaching forward and a lion on a plinth decorated with a coat of arms. Below it are ornate 19th‑century buildings lining a main street. On the right stands a mid‑20th‑century modernist block with horizontal bands of windows and a cinema at street level; a red-and-cream trolleybus and several cars travel along the avenue. In the distance, numerous church towers and baroque cupolas rise above red-tiled roofs, with hills forming the backdrop.
